column1: # Narration for the demo, one line per row, pipe separated:
#   <second on the assembled timeline>|<words>
# The assembled file is three pieces: the HyperFrames explainer (0-25s), the screen recording of the
# deployed site (25-69s), and the HyperFrames end card (69-81s). Starts are placed against the page
# map measured from the cut by verify_cut.sh, shifted by the explainer's length:
#     0.0 -  5.0  explainer: what it is
#     5.0 - 10.5  explainer: the mechanic
#    10.5 - 15.5  explainer: the two tolerances
#    15.5 - 20.0  explainer: what is held and what is not
#    20.0 - 25.0  explainer: the proof
#    25.0 - 29.5  the landing page
#    29.5 - 37.5  the overview
#    37.5 - 43.5  the case list
#    43.5 - 57.5  run a case
#    57.5 - 65.0  prove a price
#    65.0 - 69.0  the landing page, closing
#    69.0 - 75.0  end card: what is live
#    75.0 - 81.0  end card: where to look
# Numbers are spelled as they are spoken, there is no marketing vocabulary, and every claim is one
# the viewer can check on screen in the same shot. Only rows that begin with a digit are read.
# Length matters: this voice runs about 16 characters a second, and build_narration.sh refuses to
# build a track whose line outlasts the segment it is talking about.
0.4|A feed's price decides what a loan is worth.
5.4|The bonus a liquidation pays is computed from that price.
10.9|Two sources have to agree within five per cent.
15.9|The bonus is held for five minutes. The debt is not.
20.3|Anyone can challenge. The contract decides.
25.3|The deployed site, reading the chain at one block.
30.2|The bond against what the contract requires, and the bonuses still held.
37.7|Six cases here, three of them caught lies.
44.2|The feed prints the real price, then twenty percent low; the contract computes the gap.
52.8|That gap is what a challenge stakes on.
58.4|Anyone can challenge a case, no account needed.
62.4|Read beside the verdict recorded on chain.
65.6|Prices you can check, and a record you can read.
69.0|Six contracts, no pause, no setter, no upgrade, no admin key.
75.6|The dashboard is live, and every number on it is read from the chain.
